title: MA2H Resolve Request (v0.6)
description: Body of POST /v1/messages/{id}/resolve (spec §8.8) — the wire binding for resolving an open ask/task, made interoperable in v0.5 for the inter-agent leg's addressee (spec §6). The caller's identity/authorization and any session presentation ride the credential and the ?session= parameter (spec §8.8, §9.1), never the body. `cancelled` is the §8.4 verb and `expired` is Hub-only, so neither appears here. Value-vs-request validation beyond shape (membership in options[].value and its v0.6 allow_edit exemption, conformance to request.schema) is Hub-enforced (spec §8.8). `edited` is NOT a field here: it is computed by the Hub from the membership test (spec §6), and a resolver-supplied one MUST be ignored.

resolution.description: The terminal the resolver asserts: answered|declined for an ask, completed|dismissed for a task (verb-match Hub-enforced).

value.description: REQUIRED iff resolution is `answered`: the chosen option value (select/confirm; string) or the input object (input mode), per spec §5.2. For select/confirm it MUST be a member of options[].value UNLESS the request set permissions.allow_edit:true, in which case a non-member string is accepted and the Hub sets response.edited:true (v0.6, spec §5.2/§6). MUST NOT appear for any other resolution.

checklist.description: Task resolutions only: the final §5.3 checklist state, carried into the Response. MUST NOT appear for ask resolutions.
